Text: New in Hermes Agent: 

Have Hermes do an operation or set of operations on a website, and it can watch the api calls made there - then can create a static api for your agent or scripts it builds to use forevermore with this new optional skill!

Just run: 
`hermes skills install official/web-development/har-derived-api-client`
